## `dcc_bot_message_ui`

Public DCC API declaration for `dcc_bot_message_ui`.

```c
static inline dcc_status_t dcc_bot_message_ui( dcc_message_builder_t *message, const dcc_component_v2_builder_t *components, size_t component_count, uint8_t ephemeral ) { dcc_message_builder_init(message); dcc_status_t status = dcc_message_builder_set_components_v2( message, components, component_count); if (status == DCC_OK && ephemeral != 0U) { status = dcc_bot_message_ephemeral(message); } return status; }
```
